cause.what_happened: Second straight heavy fall: -15.39% on 2026-10-06 and -12.54% at 15:05 ET on 2026-10-07, mostly intraday, on 1.66x normal dollar volume. EDGAR shows no filing after 2026-09-16 and no news or rating change was found. The most plausible driver is pre-positioning ahead of the 180-day IPO lock-up expiry around 2026-10-13, which releases about 55.3M shares. That is an inference, not a sourced cause.

positioning_check: Nasdaq short interest at the 2026-09-15 settlement: 2,122,340 shares, 7.95 days to cover, +0.1% vs 08-31 (2,121,181). Shorts were flat into late September; the position carried into this fall is unobservable because of the roughly 8-business-day FINRA lag. Against a public float of about 11-13M (11.25M IPO shares plus up to 1.69M greenshoe, from the 424B4), that is roughly 16-19% of the float, a large share for a name with an unlock pending. Source: https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/ALMR/short-interest?assetclass=stocks. Insiders: 2 open-market buys and 0 sells over 3 months (Nasdaq summary). No options market, so there is no skew.

findings.finding: The 180-day IPO lock-up does not end until about 2026-10-13. It covers about 55.3M shares, roughly 4x the public float and about $1.56B at spot against $13.7M median daily turnover. The pre-expiry supply that plausibly drove the 10-06 and 10-07 falls is therefore not finished on 2026-10-08.
findings.mechanism_in_window: This is not a new disclosure. It lands in the window because the overhang is dated after the window, so any pre-expiry hedging or selling has not completed by the 2026-10-08 close and the price meets no exhausted seller.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The day after the 2026-10-06 fall (-15.39%), the stock fell another -12.54% to the screen. All 3 of its comparable falls were followed by a down next close (median -4.84%).
findings.why_not_priced: The expiry date is public, so the event is partly priced. What the price does not hold is that the selling into it is still running: the release is 3 sessions after the window, and a finished seller would show as a fall on exhausted volume, which this is not. The inference that the lock-up is the cause is unsourced, so the size is capped small.
findings.independence: Prospectus share counts: 55,271,425 restricted shares (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2104204/000119312526161647/d39680d424b4.htm). Aggregator date Oct 13 (https://stockanalysis.com/ipos/lockups/).
